hypothesis: After learning a source-blind four-feature action law, a source-blind agent can distinguish WHICH of eight unlabeled observable sensor channels has a causal effect on the earned action outcome by choosing real paid upstream bit toggles and downstream sensor interventions, without being told the mediator identity or role.

source.worlds: 32 new public synthetic development worlds 82500..82531; 4 fixed source parent structures ×8 permuted sensor assignments
source.earned_reward: 515 fixed shared actual public state/action transitions per world, delayed earned ±1 feedback from action taken 2 steps earlier (512 credited); binary action 0 or 1
source.sensors: Eight public binary channels with per-world secret permutation: six channels each respond to exactly one distinct unordered pair of the four causally relevant state bit features, two distractor channels depend on other public state bits; NONE is declared as mediator to learners.
source.true_mediator: Among the six pairwise-reactive sensors, the source-private channel tracking XOR of the two content features is the only channel whose do-value intervention changes the earned binary target action. Other five pairwise-reactive channels respond to real upstream feature toggles but do not causally influence downstream earned target.
source.public_probes: Four real current-state bit-flip interventions at common resettable baseline, revealing before/after eight sensor bits; then a real chosen binary action at baseline (paid) and each requested do(channel=1-current) intervention with an actual earned ±1 action outcome, resetting the same baseline per request. No private sensor labels, feature-role indices, future outcomes or counterfactual alternatives passed to learners.
source.seed_domain: synthetic public fixed seed; random.Random(seed+4000) for baseline, random.Random(seed+2000) permuted channel order, random.Random(seed+1000) novel public action score contexts
source.source_private_scoring: After all model choices, evaluator-only owner audit compares chosen mediator channel and inferred two content bits; 128 held public action contexts per world scored without training feedback.

arms.direct: Use unchanged source-blind CB3 DiscoveredGateBinder to identify four unordered relevant features, then a new direct-written public channel-effect matrix. Probe each four learned state bits in ascending order, shortlist sensor channels whose before/after pattern changes for exactly two of the four features; make real baseline binary action outcome observation; intervene shortlisted channels ascending until earned action reward reverses. Retain chosen channel, parent pair and public receipt; no hidden channel identity given.
arms.conventional: Use unchanged independent CB3 ConventionalExhaustiveFour to identify same relevant feature set, then independently maintain conventional hypothesis set of six two-parent sensor channels with likelihood elimination from exactly same paid public physical interventions and earned action consequences. Use identical public action budget, channel order and observations.
negatives: NO_DOWNSTREAM_INTERVENTION: same four upstream bit-probes, then select lexicographically first two-parent sensor, no downstream outcome evidence
WRONG_OUTCOME_ASSIGNMENT: same physical probe opportunities but assign first evidence of earned reward reversal to next channel rather than intervened channel; record false positive
FIXED_ACTION0: source-blind action0/no-update accuracy on 128 unseen new contexts
CB3_ACTION_PREDICTION: compare both fully trained/fit public four-feature action prediction controls, not source-private oracle

frozen_primary.four_relevant_bit_set: candidate and conventional each >=30/32 correct full four-feature set
frozen_primary.mediator_channel_discovery: both candidate and conventional identify real downstream-causal sensor channel >=30/32
frozen_primary.causal_content_pair: each infer 2 content parent bits >=30/32 by public upstream sensor effects
frozen_primary.source_mechanism_identifiability: no-downstream-intervention exact channel guess <=12/32 while active >=30/32
frozen_primary.fairness: same paid physical source opportunities and identical probe logs per world and arm, <=11 total (4+1+6)
frozen_primary.algorithm_superiority: direct minus equally informed conventional mediator-identification accuracy >=.05 AND paired 95% bootstrap lower> .01; tie=> NO_GO unique substrate
frozen_primary.memory: Bounded direct learned sensor mask + channel,parent addresses under 128 bytes role metadata; report raw logical bytes separately from process RAM and whole-process cost
frozen_primary.engineered_negative: sensor-private truth/ID never imported by either learner module and source private original FKP-17 cohorts untouched
frozen_primary.stop: Freeze original classification regardless of positive or negative. No threshold adjustment, new law examples or postscore retuning. No native model integration based on public synthetic development.

scientific_limits: No source-owner hidden evaluation or novel operator discovery; generic four-feature Boolean grammar and measurable sensor channel actions are explicitly supplied
Information is obtained by an extra source intervention, not hallucinated from unidentifiable passive observations
No GPU/paid API/runner/scheduler/controller/CI workflow edits; no source first-use or scientific promotion
DG1 physical-context investigations remain separate and unmodified.
